name: Extract Youtube Captions
summary: Extract available YouTube captions into clean text without downloading media.
description: Fetch manual or automatic captions from a YouTube URL with yt-dlp, normalize them into a safe text file, and preserve language and provenance. Use when the user requests captions or a transcript, not audio transcription.
risk_reason: It fetches captions from YouTube and writes local output, with network and downloaded-content exposure.
refuses: It does not bypass access controls, geographic restrictions, or authentication challenges.
It does not download video or audio when captions are the request.
It does not present automatic captions as an authoritative verbatim record.

entrypoints.purpose: Normalize structured YouTube json3 captions into entity-decoded plain text without repeated rolling-caption overlap.

operational.latency_reason: The skill extracts available YouTube captions into clean text without downloading media, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
